newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave names Lawrence CEO.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave names Lawrence CEO.

text.p: California Microwave Inc said its board appointed Frederick Lawrence, 49, chairman of the board, chief executive officer and president.
Lawrence joins California Microwave from ComStream Inc, where he was chief executive officer.

Al Gray held the position of chairman during the search for a new chairman and chief executive officer. He replaced chairman David Leeson, who left the company in March. Leeson had been appointed to lead the company and stabilize operations following last years's resignation of former chairman Philip Otto.
